description: NLS Autonomic Nervous System configuration. Maps to the human ANS: sympathetic (fight-or-flight, error-driven emergency sleep) and parasympathetic (rest-and-digest, scheduled maintenance sleep). Sleep stages: Triage (NREM1), Consolidation (SWS), Integration (REM).

signal_collection.description: The vagus nerve -- intercepts every response and extracts behavioral signals into a timestamped buffer with hormonal context.

circadian.description: Circadian schedule. Agent sleeps at bedtime, wakes at wake_time. Nap windows are optional daytime consolidation opportunities. When disabled, falls back to legacy reactive triggers.

signal_count.description: Determines whether a nap window is worth using and how many nightly cycles to run. No longer triggers sleep directly -- circadian schedule handles timing.

cortisol.description: Stress LOWERS threshold (sleep sooner to fix errors)

serotonin.description: Stability RAISES threshold (no rush, things are working)

error_rate.description: SYMPATHETIC activation -- emergency sleep if >90% of last 30 error/success entries were errors AND at least 30 real turns have elapsed. v1.4: raised from 0.85/25 — agentic team loops produce many recoverable errors. Also deferred when user is active (global guard).

sleep_triggers.description: Legacy triggers (idle_timeout, periodic) only used when circadian.enabled is false. signal_count now serves as nap eligibility. error_rate always active.

triage.description: NREM Stage 1 (light sleep) -- sort and prioritize collected signals. Error corrections first, then new knowledge, then behavior reinforcement.

consolidation.description: NREM Stage 3 (SWS / deep sleep) — LLM-based memory consolidation. Triage signals, store durable facts, summarize themes (no weight training).

integration.description: REM sleep -- integration and pruning. TIES-merge accumulated deltas into epoch, recalibrate thalamus routing bands, run regression check.

hormone_reset.description: Sleep reduces stress to baseline, boosts stability and reward sensitivity. The agent wakes up refreshed -- cortisol gone, serotonin elevated.

post_sleep.description: Post-sleep morning routine. Reset hormones, clear buffer, generate consolidation report, run quick self-test.

sympathetic.description: Emergency mode: high cortisol or high error rate. Prioritizes error correction, caps non-error signals. v1.4: raised from 0.40/0.50 — agentic team loops produce many recoverable errors; sympathetic mode was triggering too easily and causing repeated sleep cycles.

parasympathetic.description: Maintenance mode: default when not in emergency. Full three-phase sleep with balanced priorities.
